headerDisplay: Unofficial plugin for the Advantage Air MyPlaceIQ (Q-Hub) system. See the plugin README for how to obtain your Client ID and Client Secret from the MyPlaceIQ mobile app.
footerDisplay: This plugin polls the hub's WebSocket API on an interval; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Advantage Air.

primaryZoneControlsSystem.title: Fold whole-system control into the non-closable zone
primaryZoneControlsSystem.description: If a zone can't be independently turned off (e.g. "Family"), show it as the full system thermostat (Off/Heat/Cool + Dry/Fan) instead of creating a separate system accessory.

showPriorityZoneSwitch.title: Show a Priority switch on eligible zones
showPriorityZoneSwitch.description: Adds an extra HomeKit switch tile per zone for toggling priority mode. Off by default so each zone is just a single thermostat.

hideDryFanSwitches.title: Hide the Dry/Fan mode switches
hideDryFanSwitches.description: Removes the Dry Mode and Fan Mode switches from HomeKit entirely. Note: HomeKit's thermostat has no Dry/Fan slot, so enabling this means Dry and Fan modes become inaccessible via HomeKit (no Siri, no automations) - only Off/Heat/Cool remain controllable there.
